title: Two currencies: patrimony is territorial, honor is personal
subject: reputation-attachment-rules
ratio: (1) Patrimony is territorial: rules, registries, and doctrine belong to the domain (addendum section C.3). (2) Honor is personal: track record attaches to the identity and travels with it across cells, domains, and reassignments. (3) The split is a deliberate exception to territorial law and its completing half, not a contradiction: a right of exit disciplines a sovereign only if leaving costs the leaver nothing they earned (addendum section C.4.4's ius emigrandi). (4) Nothing in this record authorizes a consequence attaching to standing; that is the province of the Phase A ledger record (addendum section A.4) and the Phase B identity-gate record (addendum section A.5).
scope_conditions: any mechanism attaching a track record to an identity
any mechanism assigning a rule, registry or doctrine to a domain
revisit_trigger: Revisit when a second domain registry exists, or when an identity string is first retired or reassigned across cells
validity_conditions: no cell and no second domain registry exists; the founding domain is the only territory
no stored reputation balance field exists in any harness store
